title: 10% off most rail fares for travelers 65+
availability: Most Amtrak trains in the U.S.
summary: Travelers age 65+ can receive 10% off most rail fares on most Amtrak trains. Valid proof of age is required; exclusions apply.
terms: Does not apply to sleeping accommodation charges and has route/service limitations. Cross-border service has different age rules.

title: 10% senior discount for shoppers 55+
availability: U.S. stores and eligible online purchases
summary: Eligible shoppers age 55+ can receive 10% off eligible purchases after verification through Michaels Rewards or by showing valid ID in store.
terms: Exclusions and daily/product limits apply. Merchant terms can change.

title: 15% off qualifying in-store purchases on Wednesdays for 60+
summary: Customers age 60+ can receive 15% off qualifying in-store purchases every Wednesday. Bring identification to verify age.
terms: In-store only. Coupon exclusions apply and it cannot be combined with other percent-off coupons.

title: Senior rates on select sailings for travelers 55+
summary: Royal Caribbean offers senior rates on select sailings for qualifying guests age 55+. Availability and pricing vary by sailing.
terms: Capacity controlled and subject to availability. Valid ID may be required and combinability rules vary.

title: Senior rate for guests 62+ at Delta Hotels New York Times Square
availability: Delta Hotels New York Times Square
summary: A senior savings rate is available for guests age 62+ at this New York City property, with valid ID required at check-in.
terms: Offer-specific stay dates and booking terms apply. Promotional code S9R is listed by Marriott for this offer.

title: 15% off eligible Waikiki senior rates for guests 62+
summary: Selected Waikiki Marriott properties list a 15% senior discount off eligible best available rates for guests age 62+.
terms: Valid ID required. Offer dates, participating properties and availability are controlled by Marriott.

title: Special-value 55+ menu at participating IHOP restaurants
availability: Participating U.S. IHOP restaurants; pricing varies by location
summary: IHOP lists a 55+ menu with specially priced all-day favorites at participating restaurant locations. Menu items and prices vary by store.
terms: Availability, menu items and prices vary by restaurant. Select your location and confirm the current local menu before visiting.
